issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies a static method SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), but the solution implements the delivery logic under a different name: SealSaloon.receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity). Students following the specification will implement acceptSupplyDelivery, while the reference solution (and likely tests/callers) use a different identifier, leading to compilation/test failures or confusion about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename SealSaloon.receiveDelivery(String,int,int) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int), or add a public static acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) wrapper that delegates to receiveDelivery. Also update any call sites (e.g., Main) to use the specified name.
